texto: Essential vocabulary for public transport in Bangkok and the provinces: «รถไฟ» (rót-fai, train, lit. fire vehicle), «รถเมล์» (rót-mee, city bus), «สถานี» (sà-thǎa-nii, station) and «เปลี่ยน» (bplìan, to change or to transfer). For the elevated metro, «รถไฟฟ้า» (BTS) is used, and for the underground, «รถไฟใต้ดิน» (MRT). To ask how to get to a destination, the structure is: «ไป» + [Destination] + «อย่างไร» (yàang-rai, how): «ไปสถานีรถไฟอย่างไรครับ/ค่ะ». To express travelling by a means of transport: «นั่ง» (to take / to ride in) + [Vehicle]: «ฉันนั่งรถเมล์ไปทำงาน» (I go to work by bus).

opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.
